source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-42

procedures.title: A/C blower motor: replace
steps: Unplug the blower motor wire and the rubber air cooling tube.
Remove the front 3 sill plate molding screws and pry the molding out to reach the right splash shield bolts.
Remove the splash shield bolts and the splash shield.
Remove the motor-to-case screws and lower the motor out through the splash shield opening, gently prying the flange if the sealer holds it.
notes: Four-Season system. Figure 48 in the manual shows the Corvette (427 V8) compressor mounting.
